content: Dhanush M is a Full Stack Software Developer based in Tiruchirappalli (Trichy), Tamil Nadu, India. He has 2 years of professional experience building web applications, backend services, and database integrations.

Summary of All Projects by Dhanush M:
1. Dental Interface 360: Multi-role dental SaaS platform for Admin, Supplier, Practice, and Professional users built with Angular, NestJS, GraphQL, Hasura, PostgreSQL, Redis, Stripe, and Docker.
2. Lala Invoice: Full-stack invoicing and billing management application with role-based access built with React.js, Redux, Python REST APIs, and MongoDB.
3. Viral Forge: AI social media tool generating titles, descriptions, captions, and hashtags with the Gemini API and publishing to Facebook and Instagram, built with Angular, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, and Express.
4. Vignesh Metals: E-commerce mobile application for Buyer and Seller roles built with Ionic, React, Capacitor, and Node.js APIs, packaged as an Android APK.
5. CMS Website Builder: Drag-and-drop website builder with customizable UI components built with React, dnd kit, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, Multer, and Swagger.
6. Personal Portfolio: Responsive developer portfolio website with light and dark themes and dedicated project routes built with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and GSAP.
7. Face Emotion Detection: Real-time facial emotion recognition with Arduino serial hardware integration built with Python, OpenCV, Tkinter, and Arduino.

Project Detail - Dental Interface 360: A specialized multi-role dental SaaS platform for Administrators, Dental Practices, Dental Professionals, and Suppliers. Built by Dhanush at Nandalala Infotech. Tech stack: Angular, NestJS, Node.js, GraphQL, Hasura, PostgreSQL, Redis, Stripe, Firebase, Docker, GitLab CI/CD, and Contabo. Features: JWT authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), Stripe payment processing, Firebase notifications, and Redis background queues.

Project Detail - Lala Invoice: A full-stack invoicing and billing management application for small to medium businesses. Built by Dhanush at Nandalala Infotech. Tech stack: React.js, Redux, JavaScript (ES6+), CSS3, Python REST APIs, and MongoDB. Features: Complete invoice CRUD operations, automated invoice status tracking (Paid, Pending, Overdue), and role-based access for Admin and User accounts.

Project Detail - Viral Forge: An AI social media content generation and publishing web platform. Built by Dhanush as a freelance project. Tech stack: Angular, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, Gemini API, and Facebook developer APIs. Features: AI image creation from text prompts, automated title, description, caption, and hashtag generation via Google Gemini API, and direct publishing to Facebook and Instagram.

Project Detail - Vignesh Metals: An e-commerce mobile application connecting buyers and sellers for metal products. Built by Dhanush as a freelance project. Tech stack: Ionic, React, Capacitor, Node.js APIs, and Android Studio. Features: Distinct Buyer and Seller roles, product listing and purchasing workflows, and packaged as an Android APK.

Project Detail - CMS Website Builder: A no-code customizable website builder with visual drag-and-drop page design. Built by Dhanush as a freelance project. Tech stack: React, dnd kit, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Node.js, Express, Multer, and Swagger. Features: Drag-and-drop designer, customizable UI components, Multer file uploads, and Swagger API documentation.

Project Detail - Personal Portfolio: Dhanush's personal responsive portfolio website. Tech stack: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, React Router, Vite, and Netlify CI/CD. Features: Editorial typography layout (Space Grotesk and JetBrains Mono), persistent light and dark themes, deep-linked project detail pages (/projects), and NestJS backend integration.

Project Detail - Face Emotion Detection: An academic computer vision and microcontroller integration project. Built by Dhanush. Tech stack: Python, OpenCV, Tkinter, NumPy, and Arduino microcontroller. Features: Real-time facial expression classification (happy, neutral, sad) and physical hardware feedback triggered via Arduino serial communication.
